notes.title: Billie’s Wheelie Release Date Announced! 🐹💨
notes.content:
[h1][b]The wheel is spinning, and the wait is almost over! 🐹💨[/b][/h1][p]I'm excited to announce that [b]Billie’s Wheelie[/b] officially launches this [b]October 24, 2025[/b] on Steam! To kick things off, we’ve [b]dropped the very first trailer[/b]—showcasing hamster-fueled chaos, wild tracks, and non-stop racing fun.[/p][p]🎮 1–8 players, online and local racing
🐹 Hamster energy at full speed
🔥 Fast-paced challenges and hilarious chaos[/p][p]Add Billie’s Wheelie to your Wishlist and be ready when the hamsters hit the track this October![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176021/894a5c0079ba6b42289c476c0dbf241b7947b0af.png"][/img][/p]
